title: KeyRevocationSignal
description: EPR-shape provenance envelope: the authoring elohim's attestation that a governance-action:key-revocation Content entry became effective. The signal IS the provenance record, not a notification — consumers verify shape offline against this schema, verify the issuer signature over canonical envelope bytes, and consult the notary (storage projection or HDK bridge) only for authority + currentness questions. The relayChain field reserves space for relay-elohim provenance to accumulate as the signal propagates across hops.

attestationKind.description: EPR discriminator — identifies this as an authoring attestation for a key-revocation event.

subjectCid.description: Content-addressed identifier (dag-cbor sha256 CIDv1) of the governance-action:key-revocation Content entry on the elohim DNA. Substrate-agnostic — works in Holochain DHT, iroh, libp2p, IPFS, HTTP caches.

issuer.description: Base64-encoded public key of the authoring elohim's agent. The signature field is produced by this key over the canonical envelope bytes.

issuedAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the authoring elohim emitted this attestation.

signature.description: Base64-encoded ed25519 signature by issuer over the canonical envelope bytes — see spec doc for canonical serialization rules.

revocationId.description: Stable logical key — consumers dedupe on this. Format: rev-{humanId}-{ts}.

revokedPubkey.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte ed25519 public key being revoked.

agentCid.description: Stage 1: populated with humanId (stable human identifier). Stage 2: CID derived from the imagodei Human entry.

compromiseAt.description: Earliest point the key may have been compromised. M4 surface has no separate discovery timestamp; coincides with effectiveAt. EPR W2B controller sweep uses this for retroactive attestation invalidation.

effectiveAt.description: Point at which the revocation became effective in the notary's projection.

triggeringRevocationId.description: Back-pointer to the request that drove this effective event. Null for administrative or defender-path revocations (no vote chain).

supersedesCid.description: CID of the prior governance-action:key-revocation Content entry this supersedes (CREATE-only effectiveness lineage). Null on the initial CREATE.

relayChain.description: Reserved for relay-elohim provenance — each elohim that relays this signal across hops appends its own attestation. Empty in T18; populated in a future task when relay-elohims are running.
